templates.name: Alert triage
templates.description: A detection rule raises an alert; a security analyst enriches it, groups it with related alerts, decides whether it is a real threat, writes up the case and escalates it to incident response or closes it.

steps.name: Receive the alert from the monitoring tools
steps.description: Take the alert raised by a detection rule into the triage queue
steps.input_description: Alert raised by a detection rule
problems: many alerts from noisy detection rules

steps.name: Enrich the alert with context
steps.description: Look up the reputation of the addresses, domains and file hashes, and who owns the affected host and account
steps.output_description: Alert with reputation, asset and account context
problems: context copied by hand from several consoles

steps.name: Group the alert with related alerts
steps.description: Link alerts on the same host, account or time window into one case
problems: the same incident opened as several cases

steps.name: Decide whether the alert is a real threat
steps.description: Weigh the evidence and mark the case as a true or a false positive
steps.input_description: Case with its alerts and context
steps.output_description: True or false positive with the reason
problems: verdicts differ between analysts and shifts

steps.name: Write the case summary
steps.description: Summarise what happened, the evidence and the verdict in the case
problems: closing notes too short to tune the detection rule

steps.name: Escalate the incident or close the alert
steps.description: Open an incident for the response team, or close the case with its reason
problems: escalations without the evidence the responders need

templates.name: Reported phishing response
templates.description: An employee reports a suspicious email; the security team analyses it, decides whether it is phishing, removes it from every mailbox that received it, blocks the sender and tells the employee the outcome.

steps.name: Receive the reported email
steps.description: Take the email an employee reported with the report button or forwarded to the security mailbox
problems: reports forwarded without the original headers

steps.name: Extract the sender, links and attachments
steps.description: Read the headers and the body and pull out the sender, the reply-to address, the links and the attachments
problems: links hidden behind redirects and shorteners

steps.name: Check the links and attachments
steps.description: Check the reputation of each link and run each attachment in a sandbox
steps.output_description: Reputation and sandbox verdict for each indicator

steps.name: Decide whether the email is phishing
steps.description: Weigh the indicators and the content and classify the email as phishing, spam or legitimate
steps.input_description: Reported email with its checked indicators

steps.name: Purge the message from every mailbox
steps.description: Search for every copy of the message and remove it from the mailboxes that received it
problems: copies left behind when the search misses a variant

steps.name: Block the sender and the malicious links
steps.description: Add the sender, the domains and the links to the block lists of the mail gateway and the web proxy
problems: a block on a shared domain stops legitimate mail

steps.name: Tell the employee the outcome
steps.description: Thank the employee and say whether the email was phishing and what to do next
problems: employees never hear back and stop reporting

templates.name: Vulnerability management
templates.description: The scanners report vulnerabilities on the company's systems; the security team finds the owner of each asset, ranks the findings by risk, raises the fix with the owner, checks that it is in place and records the findings whose risk is accepted.

steps.name: Import the scan results
steps.description: Collect the findings of every scanner and remove the duplicates
problems: the same finding reported by two scanners

steps.name: Find the owner of each affected asset
steps.description: Match each finding to the host or application and to the team that owns it

steps.name: Rank the findings by risk
steps.description: Order the findings by severity score, likelihood of exploitation, presence in the list of known exploited vulnerabilities and exposure of the asset to the internet
steps.output_description: Findings ranked with a fix deadline
problems: every critical score treated as urgent

steps.name: Raise the fix with the owner
steps.description: Open a ticket for the owner with the finding, the fix and the deadline
steps.input_description: Findings ranked with a fix deadline
steps.output_description: Fix ticket assigned to the owner
problems: tickets without the fix or the deadline

steps.name: Check that the fix is in place
steps.description: Scan the asset again and close the ticket once the finding is gone
problems: tickets closed before the new scan

steps.name: Accept the risk of a finding that cannot be fixed in time
steps.description: Record why the finding stays open, the compensating control and the review date, and get it signed off
steps.input_description: Finding past its deadline with the owner's reason
steps.output_description: Signed risk acceptance with a review date
problems: exceptions that never come up for review
